oracle.note: gold fix + the full gated walk + the forced remediation

alt_solve.note: self-join on recorded_at <= described, no accumulator, codes written descending

alt2_solve.note: per-patient expanding walk, no long form at all, codes written in first-seen order

nc_rank_alt.note: POSITIVE despite the prefix: gold with percentile-ranked scores and the register written in an arbitrary order. Proves the terminal grades a value, not a clone of gold

nc_untouched.note: the environment as delivered, nothing driven -> strict 0

nc_do_nothing.note: perfect protocol, no fix: the export carries one row per code, so the checkpoint never goes clean and the canary is never reachable

nc_shape_only.note: the only fault the checkpoint names is repaired and nothing else. Reaches the terminal and dies on the value -- the shape/value split, demonstrated

nc_partial_fix.note: register accumulates correctly, but the delivered code table still folds the subdivided series onto its root. Proves the code table is load-bearing on its own, independently of the accumulation

nc_codes_only.note: codes reach the register exactly as charted and the archive is re-read, but the register holds only what the admission in hand charts. Proves the carry-forward is load-bearing on its own, independently of the code table

nc_textbook.note: the one-line groupby-union. Best on every visible number, wrong on the as-of boundary. MUST reach the terminal to floor -- if it dies earlier the difficulty is mislocated

nc_no_skill.note: correct register, hash-ranked scores. Drives the whole walk so it can only fail at the discrimination floor, which is the only thing that keeps that floor measured

nc_stale_cache.note: correct as-of logic reading a memoised copy of the archive out of var/. Fires the archive clause specifically

nc_vendored_snapshot.note: the archive vendored into the release. A carried snapshot is invisible to a swap, so the content rule is what closes it

nc_cheat_labels.note: candidate code hunting for the answer key from inside the scoring process. It rides the shipped register so it reaches the terminal; offline there is no privilege drop, so this only shows the path scores 0

nc_cheat_stdout.note: the entry point writes a real export, prints a passing verdict and exits. It rides the shipped register so it reaches the terminal on its own merits and floors on the value: nothing it printed was read, by the checkpoint or by the terminal

nc_one_shot.note: the correct fix by the shortest path must not reach 1.0

nc_no_recovery.note: correct fix, the shipped policy never diagnosed or repaired

nc_wrong_recovery.note: guessing the remediation family costs an attempt and the diagnosis; it is not a free retry

nc_malformed_empty.note: emptied output_path scores 0 cleanly -- a traceback is not a 0

nc_malformed_bytes.note: binary noise at output_path scores 0 cleanly

nc_malformed_truncated.note: output_path cut off mid-definition scores 0 cleanly

nc_malformed_oversized.note: output_path padded past the per-file release cap is refused at deploy.prepare

nc_malformed_wrongname.note: the fix written to a filename nothing imports. The release runs the old code, so the export still carries one row per code and the checkpoint never goes clean -- a clean 0 that never reaches the terminal
